The executor successfully implemented a robust HWPX text replacement strategy by managing XML namespaces, consolidating paragraph runs, and clearing layout caches.
Namespace registration for 'hp', 'hc', and 'hh' prevented prefix mangling during serialization. Text replacement was achieved by concatenating all '<hp:t>' content within a paragraph and clearing subsequent elements to avoid fragmented tags. The executor removed '<hp:lineSegArray>' elements to force layout recalculation and used 'zipfile' with 'ZIP_DEFLATED' to maintain document integrity.
